target_state: implemented staging handoff. The 26-instruction body was re-derived from the image bytes for this package, both direct callees were read out of the image to fix their conventions and signatures, and the single inbound reference to this VA was located in the data segment by searching the whole file for the function's own address as a little-endian dword. Outcome: the body is fully reconstructed; the two receiver words and the meaning of the value 0xff576f79 are left un-named, because nothing in the listing fixes them.

intended_paths.status: staging-only handoff; no canonical path is claimed and no other package's files were touched

implementation.argument_surface: a hidden receiver in ECX, aliased into ESI at 0x00dd06a1 and never reloaded; ZERO ordinary stack arguments on all three exits, which is derived from a linear ESP walk that ends at the entry value on each path and from the absence of an immediate on all three return sites (0x00dd06c4, 0x00dd06ea, 0x00dd06f1, each a bare C3)
implementation.receiver_model: a struct of 0x8c opaque bytes with NO named member, because the machine-derived receiver record is bounds_only and enumerates only displacements [132, 136] -- the body reads two dwords and writes nothing at all. Every access goes through a word_at(base + displacement) helper, and the .cpp static_asserts each literal displacement against the header's named constant
implementation.dispatch_model: none: the body has no indirect transfer (abi_derived.dispatch indirect_calls 0, call_offsets [], vtable_shaped_loads 0) and no model file declares a slot boundary or names a slot index. The single inbound xref is a data word at 0x0147cbe4, and the recorded table address for this VA is 0x0147cbbc, so the body is the word at that table's +0x28 -- reported, not modelled
implementation.dependency_note: both direct callees are declared extern in the package header and defined as observers in the model test, which never defines the reconstructed body itself

function_extent.return_site: three, all bare RET (bytes C3): 0x00dd06c4, 0x00dd06ea, 0x00dd06f1 -- no immediate on any
function_extent.listing_reexported: objdump -D -b binary -m i386 -M intel --adjust-vma=0x00dd06a0 over the 0x60 bytes of SPORE/SporeBin/SporeApp.exe at file offset 0x9cfaa0 (RVA 0x9d06a0) reproduces the 26 committed instructions at the same addresses with the same lengths, branch targets and operand displacements. The three branch displacements decode to +0x19 (0x75 0x19 at 0x00dd06aa, landing on 0x00dd06c5), +0x1a (0x74 0x1a at 0x00dd06cf, landing on 0x00dd06eb) and +0x11 (0x74 0x11 at 0x00dd06d8, landing on 0x00dd06eb); the two call rel32s decode to 0x00b6e250 (0x00dd06d6 - 0x26_24_86) and 0x00b6f0d0 (0x00dd06e6 - 0x26_16_16). Nothing in this model depends on a difference from the committed listing, because there is none
function_extent.trailing_padding: the bytes from 0x00dd06f2 onward are 0xcc (INT3), so nothing falls through out of this body and the 82-byte extent is the whole function

observed_original_abi.receiver_alias: ESI -- MOV ESI,ECX at 0x00dd06a1, and all three remaining receiver accesses (0x00dd06a3, 0x00dd06ac, 0x00dd06c5, 0x00dd06da) go through ESI. ECX is never used again. This is why the machine-derived receiver record reports register ECX with shape R-ALIAS: the base register it saw the receiver in is not the base register the listing's own memory operands name, so a naive ECX-only displacement scan finds nothing
observed_original_abi.stack_argument_note: none. The frame is four bytes deep from the single PUSH ESI at 0x00dd06a0, and the only other ESP movement in the whole body is 0x00dd06e0's PUSH EAX and 0x00dd06e6's ADD ESP,0x4, which are the lookup's argument and its removal. No instruction in the 26 reads a stack slot, so there is no parameter of any kind
observed_original_abi.stack_cleanup_sites: none in this body. 0x00dd06e6's ADD ESP,0x4 is the caller-side drop of the one word pushed at 0x00dd06e0 for the lookup, not an argument of this body
observed_original_abi.return_semantics_machine: EAX is written on every one of the three exits and by nothing but those: the arithmetic result at 0x00dd06be, the lookup's own EAX at 0x00dd06e1 (whose only subsequent instruction, ADD ESP,0x4, cannot change it, and whose following POP ESI does not either), and the immediate 0xff576f79 at 0x00dd06eb
observed_original_abi.ghidra_prototype: undefined FUN_00dd06a0(void), parameter_count 0, return_type undefined; its decompilation declares int __fastcall FUN_00dd06a0(int param_1) with param_1 at register:00000004
observed_original_abi.ghidra_convention_note: Ghidra reports __fastcall because a one-argument x86-32 member function and a hidden-this function are indistinguishable to it. The record disagrees (conventions.calling_convention '__thiscall', candidate set [__thiscall, __fastcall], confidence INFERRED) and the listing settles it: no instruction in the body reads EDX, and EDX is not even initialised before either call, so the second fastcall register is unused. __thiscall is the model. The disagreement is recorded rather than resolved by picking the convenient answer
observed_original_abi.dispatch: abi_derived.dispatch records indirect_calls 0, call_offsets [] and vtable_shaped_loads 0, which agrees with a 26-instruction listing whose two transfers are both direct immediates; the model therefore declares no slot boundary anywhere
observed_original_abi.callee_conventions: each fixed by the callee's own bytes, read from the image for this package: 0x00b6e250 ends in a bare C3 at 0x00b6e26a and reads no stack slot, so it is cdecl with zero arguments; 0x00b6f0d0 ends in a bare C3 at 0x00b6f132 and reads its argument as a dword at 0x00b6f0d0, so it is cdecl with one four-byte stack argument, which is why 0x00dd06e6 has to drop the pushed word itself
observed_original_abi.evidence_level: ABI_INFERRED (abi_derived.verdict = ABI_INFERRED, completeness = CORE_RESOLVED, conventions.confidence = INFERRED, parse {declared_count 26, unparsed 0, degraded false})

mechanics.body_shape: read a dword at receiver+0x84; if it equals 1, read a dword at receiver+0x88 and return 0xfffff045 when it equals 2 and 0xff576f79 otherwise; otherwise read receiver+0x88 again, return it unchanged if it already is 0xff576f79, return 0xff576f79 if a zero-argument probe returns false, and otherwise hand receiver+0x88 to a one-argument lookup and return its word. No instruction in the body writes to memory

frame_resolution.method: one linear walk of ESP through all 26 instructions. Entry ESP is 0 in the walk; 0x00dd06a0's PUSH ESI makes it -4; nothing touches ESP for the next 31 instructions; 0x00dd06e0's PUSH EAX makes it -8; 0x00dd06e6's ADD ESP,0x4 takes it back to -4; and each of the three POP ESI instructions returns it to 0 before its RET. The walk ends at 0 on all three paths
frame_resolution.corroboration: three agreements. (1) abi_derived.cleanup is {bytes 0, side caller, evidence 'ret with no immediate, no stack reads'} and abi_derived.abi lists no stack_arguments entry. (2) all three return sites are a bare C3 with no immediate, read out of the image. (3) the two callees' own terminators (bare C3 at 0x00b6e26a and 0x00b6f132) require the caller to own all cleanup, which is what a zero-argument member function is

slots.entry-8: the word pushed at 0x00dd06e0 for 0x00b6f0d0: the dword 0x00dd06da loaded, removed by 0x00dd06e6
slots.entry-4: the saved ESI, pushed at 0x00dd06a0 and popped on all three exits
slots.ordinary_arguments: none -- the receiver is the hidden this in ECX and nothing else is passed

receiver_displacement.note: this is the body's COMPLETE memory surface. There is not one store anywhere in the 26 instructions, and the two displacements below are the complete set the machine-derived receiver record enumerates: abi_derived.receiver is {register ECX, offsets [132, 136], max_offset 136, written_through 0, shape R-ALIAS}
receiver_displacement.0x84: read four times' worth of attention but only ONCE: 0x00dd06a3 `CMP DWORD PTR [esi+0x84],0x1`, a dword compare for equality against the single immediate 1. No other instruction touches this displacement, so the model reads it exactly once and the test proves a mid-flight rewrite by a callee cannot change the arm
receiver_displacement.0x88: read THREE times, at 0x00dd06ac (MOV EAX), 0x00dd06c5 (CMP against 0xff576f79) and 0x00dd06da (MOV EAX, the value pushed to the lookup). The gap between the second and the third read contains a call, so the value handed to the lookup is whatever the object holds AFTER that call, not what was compared. The model re-reads it and the model test plants the difference from inside the probe observer

kind_arm_arithmetic.claim: the 0x84 arm returns 0xfffff045 when the id equals 2 and 0xff576f79 otherwise. It does NOT return zero on any input, because the ADD at 0x00dd06be is unconditional
kind_arm_arithmetic.derivation: 0x00dd06b2 SUB EAX,0x2 makes EAX = id-2 wrapping. 0x00dd06b5 NEG EAX makes EAX = 2-id and sets CF to 1 exactly when the operand it negated was non-zero, i.e. exactly when id != 2. 0x00dd06b7 SBB EAX,EAX computes EAX-CF = -CF, so EAX is 0 for id == 2 and 0xffffffff otherwise. 0x00dd06b9 AND EAX,0xff577f34 gives 0 or 0xff577f34. 0x00dd06be ADD EAX,0xfffff045 then gives 0xfffff045 or 0xff577f34+0xfffff045 = 0xff576f79
kind_arm_arithmetic.why_it_is_not_observable_in_detail: no memory is touched between 0x00dd06ac and 0x00dd06be, there is no call, and EAX is overwritten by the very next instruction on both arms, so no black-box caller can see the intermediates. The header's kind_arm_arithmetic() transcribes the five instructions and static_asserts the resulting value table, and the model test sweeps the model against that same transcription over 40 ids
kind_arm_arithmetic.cross_check_against_the_decompiler: Ghidra's decompilation prints the same two values as `- 0xfbb` and `-0xa89087`, i.e. 0xfffff045 and 0xff576f79, from `(-(uint)(f88 != 2) & 0xff577f34) - 0xfbb`. The first version of this package's own transcription read the arm as returning ZERO for id == 2, which is what SBB alone produces; the header's static_assert caught it at compile time because the ADD is not part of the selection. It is recorded here because it is the most likely error a reader of this body will make, and this package made it

present_value_identity.claim: one 32-bit word, 0xff576f79, is simultaneously the value 0x00dd06c5 compares receiver+0x88 against, the value 0x00dd06eb materialises, and the value the 0x84 arm's arithmetic produces for every id except 2
present_value_identity.basis: the compare immediate and the store immediate are the same 6-byte encoding FF 57 6F 79 in different positions, and the arithmetic identity 0xff577f34 + 0xfffff045 == 0xff576f79 is static_asserted in the header and again in the .cpp
present_value_identity.consequence: an object whose receiver+0x88 already holds 0xff576f79 short-circuits to returning it unchanged, without entering either callee -- and the model test measures that neither observer is entered on that arm
present_value_identity.not_claimed: what the word MEANS. It is not named 'invalid', 'not found' or a null id anywhere in this package, because the 26 instructions do not say

mechanics.control_flow: exactly THREE conditional branches in the whole body, all rel8 and all with targets inside the recovered 82-byte span: JNZ 0x00dd06c5 at 0x00dd06aa (the kind discriminator), JZ 0x00dd06eb at 0x00dd06cf (the present-value shortcut) and JZ 0x00dd06eb at 0x00dd06d8 (the probe-declined shortcut). No unconditional jump, no switch, no loop, no indirect transfer. The graph is a two-level tree with THREE return sites, and two of the three conditionals share the target 0x00dd06eb
mechanics.globals: none named by the body. No instruction in the 26 references a data-segment address: the three arithmetic immediates (0x02, 0xff577f34, 0xfffff045) and the present value 0xff576f79 are all values, and none of them lies in 0x01300000..0x02000000. The body's CALLEES do name data words (0x01687978 and 0x0156b0cc inside 0x00b6e250; 0x0156b0b8 and 0x13f2100 inside 0x00b6f0d0); those are recorded in the header as context and read by nothing in this model

direct_call_1.arguments: none. The instruction before the call is 0x00dd06cf's JZ, which defines no register and touches no stack, and the callee's own 27-byte body reads no stack slot at all
direct_call_1.cleanup: none on either side; the callee's terminators are bare C3 at 0x00b6e267 and 0x00b6e26a
direct_call_1.return: 0 or 1 in EAX, tested as ONE BYTE by 0x00dd06d6 `TEST AL,AL`
direct_call_1.callee_body_read_for_this_package: CMP DWORD PTR ds:0x01687978,0 / JE / CMP DWORD PTR ds:0x0156b0cc,0 / JE / MOV EAX,1 / RET / XOR EAX,EAX / RET. So the callee answers 1 only when both of those data words are non-zero. That is a fact about the CALLEE, recorded to describe it, and asserted by nothing here
direct_call_1.interpretation: a readiness/initialisation gate over two globals, and the model names it db_ready_probe for that reason. INFERRED, not established: nothing in this body or in the callee's own bytes identifies either global. See unresolved_questions item 4

direct_call_2.arguments: the dword at receiver+0x88, BY VALUE. 0x00dd06da loads it, 0x00dd06e0 pushes it, and the callee's first instruction is a dword load of that slot (0x00b6f0d0). The pointer level is one, and the model test's observer records the value and requires it to be neither the address of the word nor the receiver's address nor the receiver
direct_call_2.cleanup: caller-side, ADD ESP,0x4 at 0x00dd06e6, because the callee's terminator is a bare C3 at 0x00b6f132
direct_call_2.return: a 32-bit word in EAX, which this body passes straight through as its own return
direct_call_2.callee_body_read_for_this_package: 0x00b6f0d0..0x00b6f132, 0x63 bytes. It takes the address of its own argument (LEA ECX,[esp+4]), pushes it, loads ECX with 0x0156b0b8, calls 0x00b6ee40, and then packs three scaled float lanes from the returned record into EAX with cvttss2si, OR 0xffffff00, SHL 8, AND 0xff and OR. The interior is the callee's and is NOT modelled; only the signature is used
direct_call_2.interpretation: a keyed lookup that returns a packed 32-bit word built from three floats. INFERRED from the callee's own bytes, and the packed-float reading is not asserted by anything in this package. See unresolved_questions item 4

mechanics.callee_order: stores (none) -> kind test (1) -> [0x84 arm] OR -> present-value test (2) -> probe (3) -> id re-read (4) -> lookup (5) -> return. The probe is UNCONDITIONAL on the lookup arm: only the present-value test can skip it, and a reconstruction that inverted the probe's result test is killed with 714 assertion failures
mechanics.write_ordering: there is no write ordering to get wrong in the model, because the body performs no writes at all. The ordering that IS load-bearing is the RE-READ: 0x00dd06da reloads receiver+0x88 after 0x00dd06c5 compared it and after the probe ran, and a reconstruction that cached the compared value is killed by 54 assertion failures, driven by the probe observer overwriting the word from inside the call
mechanics.not_modelled: the 0xcc padding from 0x00dd06f2 onward, which nothing can reach; the interiors of both callees; the two globals 0x00b6e250 tests; and the meaning of the two receiver words and of 0xff576f79

return_semantics.value: one of exactly three things. 0xfffff045, on the single input where the kind is 1 and the id is 2. 0xff576f79, from three separate exits: the 0x84 arm for every other id, the present-value shortcut, and the declining probe. Or the lookup's own 32-bit word, passed through untouched on the remaining path
return_semantics.signed_view: 0xfffff045 is -4027 and 0xff576f79 is -0xa89087 = -6898823, which is how Ghidra's decompilation prints them (`- 0xfbb` and `-0xa89087`). The model declares std::int32_t because the arithmetic is written in the listing as signed-shaped SUB/NEG/AND/ADD and the decompiler types it int; the model test compares on the unsigned bit pattern in every case, so the two views cannot disagree
return_semantics.ownership: nothing is acquired or released. The body reads the receiver and never writes it, and it allocates nothing
return_semantics.lifetime: nothing is frame-borne. The one pushed word is the lookup's argument and is removed by the body itself at 0x00dd06e6. The body's only output is the returned word, plus whatever the lookup did to the object it was given -- which it was not given, only the id
return_semantics.why_not_void_and_why_not_a_pointer: EAX is written on every exit by the instructions above, so the value is real; and it is neither the receiver nor a member of it on any path, so it is not a pointer. The derived ABI record classifies that EAX as `aggregate_unknown` with return_semantics 'unclassified_in_EAX', which is a statement about its width classifier rather than about the listing -- see validation.expected_reasons.RETURN SEMANTICS and unresolved_questions item 1

evidence.decompiler_disagreements: two, and neither touches a modelled point. (1) The convention: it says __fastcall where the record says __thiscall and the listing settles it (no instruction reads EDX). (2) Its own signature reports zero parameters and an undefined return type while its decompilation body clearly takes a receiver and returns int. Everything else -- both receiver displacements, the equality against 1, the two-valued arithmetic of the 0x84 arm, the two equality tests, the call order, the argument passed by value, and all three returned words -- agrees with the listing, including the -0xfbb and -0xa89087 renderings that are the two constants in their signed spelling
direct_callees: 0x00b6f0d0 FUN_00b6f0d0 (sporepedia_lookup_packed_00b6f0d0, cdecl, one dword by value, returns a 32-bit word)
evidence.caller_note: There is no direct caller, and that is not a gap in a caller search. The single inbound xref the export carries is the data word at 0x0147cbe4, and a search of the whole 20,454,960 byte image for this function's own address as a little-endian dword (a0 06 dd 00) returns EXACTLY ONE hit, at file offset 0x107bfe4, which maps to VA 0x0147cbe4. So the body is reached by dispatch and by no direct call anywhere in the image, and there is no second reference of any kind to audit

unresolved_questions: The derived ABI record and the listing disagree on the RETURN CLASSIFICATION, and the listing wins. abi_derived.return is {register EAX, register_class aggregate_unknown, type null} and the persisted projection renders it as return_semantics 'unclassified_in_EAX'. The listing is unambiguous: three return sites, three writes to EAX, and a 32-bit value on each. The model's declared return type is std::int32_t, which is a different string, so the validator's RETURN SEMANTICS check will take its semantically-renamed arm. This was checked against the stricter route before the source was written -- evidence_returns.decide defers by its own rule whenever any ABI source carries a return_type or return_semantics claim, so that path cannot adjudicate this target at all. Reported, not chased.

Is 0x0147cbbc really the start of a function table? The word at 0x0147cbbc + 0x2c is 0xf0ff0300, which is below the image base and therefore not a code address, in a run where every other word read is a code address or a data address. So either the table starts elsewhere, or something is patched at run time, or the word is a value the collector's table-start heuristic walked past. The package does not resolve it, and it is also not load-bearing: the machine-checked fact is that the body's own address appears exactly once in the image as a dword, and that word is at 0x0147cbe4. No slot index and no slot boundary is declared anywhere in the model, so nothing here depends on the table's start.

What does 0xff576f79 MEAN? It is demonstrably one value doing three jobs -- the arm's fallback answer, the compare that short-circuits the lookup, and the store on the shared tail -- but nothing in the 26 instructions, and nothing in either callee's own bytes, says whether it is an invalid marker, a null id, a hash, or a coincidence of two unrelated constants that happen to agree. The package names it kAbsentValue, which is a description of its role and NOT a claim about its meaning. See mechanics.present_value_identity and its not_claimed.

What are the two receiver words? The word at receiver+0x84 is switched on by two neighbouring members of the same recorded table (0x00dd0650 and 0x00dd0990) through the same DEC / CMP 0x4 / JA five-way jump table, which fixes it as a small discriminant with five arms plus a default; the word at receiver+0x88 is compared against a 32-bit constant and handed to a lookup. Neither is named in this package, because the record is bounds_only and two read-only dwords cannot say what a member is. The discriminant's enum values and the looked-up value's type are not recoverable from this body, and no SDK symbol was recovered for this VA (ghidra_function.sdk_name is null) and the binary has no MSVC RTTI.

What is the class, and is 0x00dd0b50 its constructor? The recorded table for this VA is 0x0147cbbc; the constructor at 0x00dd0b50 installs 0x0147c9f8, a different table. The two tables share the accessor family 0x00641810 / 0x00641820 / 0x00641850 / 0x006414e0, so they belong to related types in one hierarchy, and the sibling package pkg-swarm-w1-00dd0bc0 reconstructs 0x00dd0bc0 (a destructor on the 0x0147c9f8 table) with the same receiver family. Whether 0x00dd0b50 and this body are the same class, a base and a derived, or two siblings, is NOT settled here and no class name is used anywhere in this package.

Is 0x00dd06d1's call really argument-free, as a behavioural matter? As a STATIC matter it is: the instruction before the call is 0x00dd06cf's JZ, no instruction pushes for it, and 0x00b6e250's own body reads no stack slot. It is NOT observable through a compiled model, which balances its own pushes, and the model test says so rather than pretending to check it. Two instruments that tried were withdrawn and the reasons are recorded in the model test's own file: a stack-depth difference measured 48 bytes of the compiler's -O0 frame where the listing's prologue accounts for 4, and a read of the word above the callee's return address read the compiler's 12 bytes of call-alignment padding rather than the argument slot. What is asserted instead is the observable content: the model's frame is balanced across the call and the caller's own stack word is untouched when it returns (C1, C3).

Is 0x00dd06e6's ADD ESP,0x4 the callee's or the caller's? The callee's own terminator is a bare C3 with no immediate, so it is the caller's -- that is established by real evidence. But for a cdecl leaf callee that does not touch the caller's stack, a callee-pops and a caller-pops return are the same machine behaviour, and no black-box observer can tell them apart. Reported as a known limit of the test, not as an open question about the reconstruction.
Not fixable from this package, reported not chased: GLOBALS and EVIDENCE COVERAGE are structurally WARN. See validation.expected_reasons and known_blockers.

conditions: The original process is driven to an object of this class once per kind value 1..5 (0x00dd0650 and 0x00dd0990 both switch on it over five cases) and once with kind outside that range, so that all three of this body's exits execute live.

validation.model_test: plain int main() with explicit named checks, no framework and no external dependency. Both direct callees are defined in the test as observers that record their call count, their argument, the call order, the object as it stood at the moment of the call, and -- on instruction -- an option to rewrite the object from inside the call. Seventeen cases in six groups: A1 sweeps the 0x84 arm against an independent transcription of the five arithmetic instructions over 40 ids; A2 drives the kind test's polarity in both directions including three byte-width decoys; A3 pins the arm's answer at six ids one bit apart; A4 plants decoy dwords one below and two above the modelled receiver and a poisoned pointee and requires that none is ever returned; A5 drives the four one-bit neighbours of the present value. B1..B6 cover the other two arms: the short-circuit that skips both callees, the probe gate in both polarities, the value-versus-pointer argument, the re-read of the id after the probe (30 rewrite combinations), the once-only sampling of the kind word, and the call order. C1..C6 are the measurements: a raw-call trampoline (top-level asm) samples ESP and EAX across a call, reads back its own stack word afterwards, and pushes a decoy object so that [ESP+4] holds it while ECX holds the real receiver.
